nodes.text: Know someone who’s been sick with a nasty respiratory condition (not flu, not Covid)? Very likely it’s human metapneumovirus (HMPV). Google it. It’s being reported around the country. No vaccine is available; treatment consists of symptom management. https://t.co/kDqDmRMeC2
